prompts.title: 奢华腕表的微距摄影
prompts.description: 一个详细的提示，用于拍摄一款奢华腕表（WASI – W Eclipse Edition）的微距照片，腕表置于反光的黑色大理石表面上，重点突出双色表壳、镂空“W”结构展现的齿轮等精致细节，并采用富有戏剧性的电影级灯光，营造出高端广告的视觉效果。
prompts.content:
A macro photograph of an expensive, luxury wristwatch, the '{argument name="watch model" default="WASI – W Eclipse Edition"}'. The watch has a prominent two-tone case made of brushed titanium and polished rose gold with angular, complex lines. The crown, also in rose gold, has a micro-engraved 'W' emblem. The watch is placed in a three-quarter view, angled towards the right, on a highly reflective black marble surface with prominent white veining, which shows a partial reflection of the watch and its band.
​The dial is deep obsidian black, radiating a subtle sunburst pattern from the center. Its defining feature is a large, sculptural, open-worked 'W' structure made of polished metallic components that arches across the center, revealing the intricate mechanical gears of the movement beneath it. The floating 'W' serves as a dominant central element. The hours are marked by applied rose gold hour markers, with Roman numerals '12', '3', and '6'. Minute markers are visible along the outer edge. The brand name 'WASI' is minimalistically engraved at the 12 o'clock position in brushed platinum lettering.
​The hands are skeletonized and geometric, made of polished rose gold with integrated ice-blue luminous material that glows softly. There are two main hands and a central seconds hand. The strap is black matte crocodile leather with a polished rose gold deployant clasp that also has a micro-engraved 'W' insignia.
​In the background, slightly out of focus, are luxury elements including a black velvet-lined box and a wooden panel with the text 'WASI' clearly engraved, suggesting a display. The lighting is dramatic and cinematic, with soft highlights and deep shadows that emphasize the varied textures, making it look like a high-end Swiss watch advertisement.
prompts.translatedContent:
一款昂贵的奢华腕表的微距照片，型号为“{argument name="watch model" default="WASI – W Eclipse Edition"}”。这款腕表拥有引人注目的双色表壳，由拉丝钛金属和抛光玫瑰金制成，线条棱角分明，复杂精巧。表冠同样采用玫瑰金材质，并微雕有“W”标志。腕表以四分之三的视角放置，向右倾斜，置于高度反光的黑色大理石表面上，大理石带有明显的白色纹理，映照出腕表及其表带的部分倒影。

表盘呈深邃的黑曜石色，从中心散发出微妙的放射状太阳纹。其标志性特征是一个大型、雕塑般的镂空“W”结构，由抛光金属部件制成，横跨表盘中央，展现出下方机芯精密的机械齿轮。这个悬浮的“W”作为主导性的中心元素。小时刻度由镶贴的玫瑰金时标表示，其中“12”、“3”和“6”为罗马数字。分钟刻度沿外缘可见。品牌名称“WASI”以拉丝铂金字体在 12 点钟位置简约地镌刻。

指针是镂空且几何形状的，由抛光玫瑰金制成，并集成有柔和发光的冰蓝色夜光材料。腕表有两根主指针和一根中央秒针。表带为黑色哑光鳄鱼皮材质，配有抛光玫瑰金折叠扣，折叠扣上也微雕有“W”徽章。

背景中，略微失焦的是一些奢华元素，包括一个黑色天鹅绒内衬的盒子和一个清晰刻有“WASI”字样的木质面板，暗示着一个展示场景。灯光富有戏剧性和电影感，柔和的高光和深邃的阴影强调了各种纹理，使其看起来像一则高端瑞士腕表广告。

prompts.description: 一个详细的提示，用于使用 Nano Banana Pro 生成超逼真的全身影棚时尚肖像。它强调准确的比例、特定的服装再现，以及具有受控照明和干净背景的专业影棚设置。姿势应由服装风格决定，而不是复制参考。
prompts.content:
proportions, hairline, and overall likeness with high accuracy. Do not beautify, stylize, or alter their identity.

Facial expression:
calm, confident, or warm smile with direct eye contact toward the camera.

Body Proportions

Maintain realistic human proportions based on the person reference image.

Preserve:

body shape

shoulder width

natural posture

Do not exaggerate body shape.

Outfit Recreation

The subject must wear the exact outfit from the outfit reference image.

Recreate clothing accurately including:

colors

fabric type

patterns and prints

garment structure

folds and stitching

clothing layers

The outfit should appear naturally worn and properly fitted to the subject.

Pose Logic (Important)

Do not copy the pose from any reference image.

Instead, determine the pose based on the style of the outfit.

Examples:

Modern / streetwear outfits → relaxed modern fashion pose
Formal outfits → confident professional standing pose
Casual outfits → natural relaxed pose

The pose should look like a professional fashion studio photoshoot.

Composition

Professional studio fashion portrait.

Full body framing from head to toe (very important).

Aspect ratio 4:5 vertical.

Subject positioned naturally in the center of the frame.

Background

Create a clean professional studio sweep background.

Background characteristics:

smooth light grey seamless backdrop

backdrop curves smoothly into the floor

darker grey studio floor

subtle gradient lighting on the background

No objects or props.

Lighting

Professional studio lighting:

soft front key light

balanced fill light

subtle rim light for separation

evenly illuminated background

Lighting must look natural and professional.

Image Style

Ultra-realistic studio photography.

Requirements:

photorealistic skin texture

detailed fabric rendering

sharp focus

natural shadows

professional fashion photography look

Restrictions

No extra people
No text
No logos
No props
No background objects
No half-body portrait
Subject must be fully visible from head to toe

面部比例、发际线和整体相似度要高度准确。不要美化、风格化或改变其身份。

面部表情：
平静、自信，或带着温暖的微笑，目光直视镜头。

身体比例

根据人物参考图保持真实的人体比例。

保留：

体型
肩宽
自然姿态

不要夸大体型。

服装再现

主体必须穿着与服装参考图完全相同的服装。

准确再现服装，包括：

颜色
面料类型
图案和印花
服装结构
褶皱和缝线
服装层次

服装应看起来自然穿着，并与主体合身。

姿势逻辑（重要）

不要复制任何参考图中的姿势。

而是根据服装风格来确定姿势。

示例：

现代/街头服饰 → 轻松的现代时尚姿势
正装 → 自信的专业站姿
休闲服饰 → 自然放松的姿势

专业的影棚时尚肖像。

从头到脚全身构图（非常重要）。

纵向宽高比 4:5。

主体自然地置于画面中央。

背景

创建干净专业的影棚背景。

背景特征：

光滑的浅灰色无缝背景布
背景布平滑地过渡到地面
深灰色影棚地面
背景上微妙的渐变照明

无物体或道具。

专业影棚灯光：

柔和的前主光
平衡的补光
用于分离的微妙轮廓光
均匀照明的背景

灯光必须看起来自然且专业。

超现实的影棚摄影。

照片级真实的皮肤纹理
精细的面料渲染
清晰的焦点

专业的时尚摄影外观

限制

无额外人物
无文字
无标志
无道具
